description: MPF4393 N-channel JFET switch (our model from onsemi's sheet)

source.licence: Our own model built from the maker's data sheet (D-159, D-161): the values are Solum Builder's

package.name: TO-92 (DSG)
package.source: onsemi MPF4392/D Rev. 6, page 1: TO-92 Style 5, 1 drain, 2 source, 3 gate

fit.figure: Electrical characteristics (no typical DC curve on the sheet)
fit.method: Idss and Vp the geometric middles of 5-30 mA and -0.5 to -3.0 V (12.2 mA, -1.22 V); BETA = Idss/Vp²; CGD = Crss 2.5 pF, CGS = Ciss − Crss = 3.5 pF (typical). Its gm at 5 mA is 12.8 mS against the sheet's typical 12 mS, and its on-resistance 50 Ω against 100 Ω max
fit.note: Real units spread over the sheet's whole range; a circuit's measured Idss and Vp replace these (D-130)
